The frequently asked, answered

Who do we consider to be a student?

A student is anyone currently enrolled, or admitted and planning to enroll in the next 3 months, at an accredited university, community college or other higher education institution.

What happens to my Quicksilver Rewards for Students card when I graduate from school?

Although you are graduating, your Capital One Quicksilver Rewards card stays with you. You’ll still keep all the same rewards and benefits on your card.
